title: Linux Kernel — SocketCAN
summary: Linux exposes CAN interfaces through its networking API, including virtual interfaces.
project_implication: CAN adapter design; virtual CAN cannot validate electrical or arbitration behavior.

title: 3GPP TS 23.287 v16.6.0 / ETSI TS 123 287
review_status: Relevant architecture and coverage clauses inspected
summary: Distinguishes PC5 direct communications from network-based V2X and specifies provisioning constraints.
project_implication: Use for link/failure taxonomy; historical edition, not a claim of current regional compliance.

title: ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1 — Cooperative Awareness
summary: Defines CAM fields and message behavior; heading uses true north.
project_implication: A decoder must preserve units, unavailable codes and coordinate conventions; freeze the required profile.

title: ETSI TS 103 097 v2.1.1 — Security header and certificates
review_status: Search screening only; full review pending
summary: Security headers and certificate formats are a separate layer from detecting misleading telemetry.
project_implication: A newer 2026 edition appeared in the ETSI publication listing; verify the target edition before implementation.

title: AUTOSAR R24-11 — Requirements on Secure Onboard Communication
review_status: Search screening only; full text fetch unavailable
summary: SecOC is relevant to authenticated, fresh in-vehicle messages.
project_implication: Candidate reference for the separate CAN track; not evidence of implementation or conformance.

title: van der Heijden et al. — VeReMi (2018)
review_status: Abstract and official family overview screened
summary: Introduces reproducible simulated misbehavior data for comparable evaluation.
project_implication: Historical benchmark and backward citation starting point; full paper extraction pending.

title: VeReMi Extension (2020) — official dataset overview
summary: Adds simulated sensor errors and more misbehavior variants to the original benchmark.
project_implication: Candidate external benchmark; do not describe it as field-recorded attack traffic.

title: VeReMi NextGen (2026) — official overview
summary: Provides simulated CAM logs, official splits, pseudonyms and a newer scenario setup. Attacks are applied after baseline simulation.
project_implication: Candidate main benchmark; offline injected DoS does not by itself demonstrate live channel disruption.

title: VeReMi NextGen — message format
summary: Documents rcvTime/sendTime in nanoseconds, sender_alias, sender_id and sender/receiver measurements.
project_implication: Use receiver-visible pseudonyms; block hidden identity, labels, driver profiles and oracle metadata from model inputs.

title: nuScenes — CAN bus expansion
summary: Real scene telemetry includes timestamped pose, IMU, steering and vehicle-monitor measurements; documentation calls this expansion experimental.
project_implication: Use for benign motion realism, not as a ready-made labelled V2X cyberattack benchmark.

title: Fraunhofer HHI — BerlinV2X
summary: Real cellular/sidelink radio measurements and GPS tracks are available.
project_implication: Use for benign communication impairment characterization; exact timing semantics and attack-label availability require a sample audit.

title: ORNL — A comprehensive guide to CAN IDS data and ROAD
summary: ROAD combines real vehicle CAN captures and attacks with simulated masquerade cases, from one vehicle.
project_implication: Evaluate CAN separately; real data and real attacks are different labels.

title: ROAD dataset release
summary: Release includes ambient and attack captures and points to the associated paper.
project_implication: Pin files, license, checksums and attack provenance before use.

title: AIR-THU — DAIR-V2X / V2X-Seq
summary: Real cooperative perception and trajectory resources are provided.
project_implication: Optional perception track; image/point-cloud labels are not message-attack labels.

title: Veins — framework and founding paper link
summary: Couples OMNeT++ communication models with SUMO mobility.
project_implication: Candidate network-first simulator; validate the selected radio model rather than assuming PC5 support.

title: CARLA — SUMO co-simulation
summary: Provides a documented CARLA/SUMO synchronization workflow.
project_implication: Useful for sensor/driving scenarios; extra radio integration still needs engineering.

title: CARLA — packaged quick start
summary: The inspected package guide lists Windows/Ubuntu and recommends a dedicated GPU.
project_implication: Do not assume the user’s Apple Silicon Mac can run the chosen package natively; verify a lab host and exact release first.

title: Eclipse MOSAIC
summary: A framework for coupling mobility, application and communication simulators.
project_implication: Candidate when reproducing NextGen; coupling support does not mean every version combination works.

title: CTTC — 5G-LENA
summary: An ns-3-based 5G NR simulation project with related NR-V2X work.
project_implication: A PC5 study must verify a compatible sidelink branch/module and its model assumptions; generic NR support is insufficient.

title: Hyperledger Fabric — Ordering service
summary: Documents crash-tolerant Raft and BFT ordering introduced in Fabric v3.0, and the need to check peer commit validity.
project_implication: Select according to the adversary model; receipt acknowledgement is not committed evidence.

title: Hyperledger Fabric — Private data
summary: Collections restrict which organizations hold private application data.
project_implication: Candidate privacy mechanism, not automatic protection for all metadata or traffic.

title: Besu — QBFT
summary: Permissioned validators finalize blocks using QBFT; insufficient participating validators stall progress.
project_implication: Candidate EVM network; test loss of quorum, governance and separate administrative control.

title: Arp et al. — Dos and Don’ts of ML in Computer Security (USENIX Security 2022)
review_status: Abstract and relevant full-text evaluation pitfalls inspected
summary: Highlights biased collection, leakage, weak metrics and unrealistic threat models in security ML.
project_implication: Guides grouped splits, fair tuning, base-rate analysis and deployment-oriented validation.

title: Lundberg & Lee — A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions (2017)
summary: Introduces SHAP as additive attribution of model outputs.
project_implication: Explain the model’s reasoning; do not interpret attribution as causal proof of an attack.

title: Chen & Guestrin — XGBoost (2016)
summary: Describes a scalable tree-boosting system.
project_implication: Motivates a candidate; it does not establish superiority on RoadTrust’s data.

title: Guo et al. — On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks (2017)
summary: Studies confidence calibration and post-processing for neural models.
project_implication: Calibration background; reported neural results are not direct evidence for calibrating this forest.

title: scikit-learn — Probability calibration
review_status: Reference page opened; detailed method review pending
summary: Reference for probability-calibration workflows.
project_implication: Fit calibration without touching the final test set; verify methods against the pinned version.

title: scikit-learn — Cross-validation
review_status: Reference page opened; detailed splitter review pending
summary: Reference for grouped and temporal model evaluation.
project_implication: Implement grouping from the actual recording lineage, not merely a random row split.

title: scikit-learn — RandomForestClassifier.predict_proba
summary: A forest score averages tree class probabilities; it need not equal the fraction of hard tree votes.
project_implication: Correct existing score descriptions; retain the uncalibrated-score warning.

title: FastAPI — Features
summary: Supports API schemas and validation around Python services.
project_implication: Proposed backend wrapper around the existing pipeline; authentication policy still needs implementation.

title: MLflow — Experiment tracking
summary: Records parameters, versions, metrics and artifacts.
project_implication: Proposed run catalog; data lineage and split integrity still require project code.
